subject.title: feat(channels): add pre-auth access requests and grouped DM allowlists

question: Should this workflow be redesigned around canonical `accessGroups` with explicit pre-auth activation, or should OpenClaw intentionally support fixed per-sender trust tiers and automatic trusted-hook activation as a second contract?
rationale: Implementation evidence can establish that the workflow operates, but it cannot choose the permanent config/API model or authorize the pre-admission privacy and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Refactor To Canonical Groups
options.body: Retain the pre-auth workflow, use `accessGroups` and matched-group metadata, and require explicit activation for content-bearing hooks.

options.title: Approve Parallel Trust Tiers
options.body: Accept the six fixed labels and grouped allowlist objects only with explicit compatibility, privacy, and upgrade documentation and ownership.

options.title: Split Or Pause
options.body: Separate the generic pre-auth API from grouping and access-request automation, or pause the broad proposal until the full direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Refactor To Canonical Groups
recommendation.body: Retain the pre-auth workflow, use `accessGroups` and matched-group metadata, and require explicit activation for content-bearing hooks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the shared ingress, allowlist, config-mutation, and plugin SDK decision surface.
